high_level_description: stc brand style, a modern trade show booth with an illuminated stc logo on a purple and blue geometric wall.

compositional_deconstruction.background: An indoor exhibition hall with exposed industrial ceiling elements, metal trusses, hanging lights, and other booths visible in the background, lit with deep purple and bright blue illumination.

elements.desc: A sleek trade show booth with multiple illuminated panels and screens, a white backlit panel on the left and vibrant blue and purple lighting on the right.
Several people in business attire gathered in small groups near the display, captured with motion blur.
A large illuminated logo mounted on the purple and blue geometric wall structure.
A blue directional sign mounted on the upper left of the booth.
